We have everything you are searching for to complete your project. We have DIY guides that provide inspiration and product details. Remember to check back frequently to see our latest sales and promotions!Frequently Asked Questions About The Home DepotCan The Home Depot deliver large quantities of items for my project?The Home Depot offers comprehensive bulk delivery services to get large amounts of materials directly to your job site, business, or home. Whether you're purchasing pallets of lumber, bags of concrete, or multiple appliances, we can handle the heavy lifting. This service is perfect for major renovations, large-scale DIY projects, or new construction, saving you trips and hassle.What is your return policy?We make returns easy. You can return an item in-store or by mail. Most items can be returned within 90 days with proof of purchase. Learn more by checking out our full return policy.How quickly can I get my online order delivered?The Home Depot offers super fast delivery options for your convenience! Many items are eligible for same-day delivery to your job site or home, often within just a few hours. For an even wider selection, you can get thousands of qualifying items delivered by next-day delivery. Enter your ZIP code on the product page or at checkout to see the fastest options available for the items you want.Can I see when my order will arrive?We've made it easier than ever to check your order status and scope out your delivery day. From processing to shipping, it's a breeze to check your order status.What's on sale at The Home Depot?Check out our Savings Center to get the scoop on deals. From holiday savings to one-day-only specials, we have a variety of ways to save on your next project.How much fencing will I need?Does The Home Depot offer discounts for military?How do I check my Home Depot gift card balance?Home Depot gift cards are a popular choice during the holiday season or for any occasion. DIYers know these gift cards are fun to give and receive. They can be purchased in stores or online at homedepot.com. If you're a recipient, you can check your gift card balance online or visit your closest Home Depot and ask a cashier to check the balance for you. Redeem our gift cards in-store or use them to shop online with no extra fees.Does The Home Depot have an app?The Home Depot's mobile app was made for doing. Use the store mode to find out what's in stock and where it's located in your neighborhood store. Our barcode scanner pulls up product details, ratings, and reviews so you can learn more before you purchase. Image search helps you find out exactly what something is, so it's easier to find it. Our app includes many other features like augmented reality for certain products, easy payments, and shopping lists.
